existing_portable_bytes.window_scheduler: F06W owns processed/startup/pending counters semantically, but no F06W standalone portable byte serializer is declared
existing_portable_bytes.sample_block_queue: Use actual owner counters and actual queued sample values; no processed/pcm_ring_count alias is defined
existing_portable_bytes.lfe_delay_ring: F06OF defines the typed three-slot ring content/provenance but no named portable serializer; use a local canonical typed representation with all frame words.

local_deterministic_decisions: Canonical root is complete materialized owner value plus input identity; receipt excluded.
SampleBlockQueueState field names are supplied by Wash implementation report and are kept as direct local owner fields; F06W does not define their named alias map.
F06W processed remains its own published-valid-sample counter. No pcm_ring_count alias is synthesized. Complete pending per-lane sample words are materialized.
MeterLfeDelayState is its own owner. Keep all three frame values/origins and ring cursors; no alias to source cursor or F06W processed.
Any existing portable leaf bytes are nested verbatim; local JSON fields use exact unsigned words for F32 bit patterns and canonical decimal integers for clocks.
